text: Introduction 1.The transformation of operations in the public sector as a result of e-Government practices and what this means for professionals working with or in the public arena; 2.The central role of strategic planning in the development of e-Government practices; 3.The IT trends (hardware, software, disaster recovery) making an impact in public sector organizations; 4.The tools, techniques and methodologies involved in successfully managing IT projects within a public service organization. Degree Award Doctor of Management
